recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆漿細胞核偏位、染色質粗塊，胞質豐富且帶淡紫紅色調而非一般的深藍色，這種胞質富含免疫球蛋白的樣子就是火焰細胞（flame cell），常與 IgA 骨髓瘤相關。
features: Plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus and clumped chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm with a pinkish-lilac (reddish-purple) hue instead of deep blue
Adjacent large cell with round nucleus and fine chromatin
Background myelocytes, band neutrophils, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed hematopoietic elements including granulocytic precursors, band neutrophils and erythroid precursors. A plasma cell in the center displays an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and abundant cytoplasm with a reddish-purple (flame-like) tint, representing a 'flame cell'. The fuchsia coloration is relatively subtle in this preparation. Flame cells reflect immunoglobulin-rich cytoplasm and are most often associated with IgA plasma cell myeloma, though they are not specific and can occur in reactive plasmacytosis.

ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale Russell bodies (grape-like) rather than diffusely pink cytoplasm.
Granulocytic precursors show azurophilic or specific granules and a paler perinuclear Golgi area without the plasma cell's clumped clock-face chromatin.
Reactive plasma cells usually have deep blue cytoplasm with a hof and are polytypic on kappa/lambda studies.
Thesaurocytes are enlarged plasma cells with abundant pale-to-pink cytoplasm distending the cell; the distinction from flame cells is descriptive rather than diagnostic.
